## SK Hynix Commits ₩54 Trillion to AI Memory Fab Construction in South Korea

Korea-anchored domestic construction rather than overseas capacity means SK Hynix is concentrating HBM supply in South Korea, reducing geopolitical exposure to China but increasing the strategic sensitivity of Korean fab capacity to US-Korea relations and export policy developments.

- SimplyWall.st reports SK Hynix's commitment at ₩54 trillion — the Korean-won equivalent of the $38B figure reported internationally.
- Domestic Korean construction emphasis means jobs, supply chain activity, and regulatory benefits are anchored in South Korea.
- High-confidence classifier tag; corroborates the announcement scale from a local-currency, domestic-audience perspective.
- No new operational detail beyond currency denomination and Korea-build confirmation.
